title: Catalog Core System
description: A four-image continuity series that anchors one industrial catalog system from cover to hero spread.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes one original industrial product family and its catalog art direction. Images 02-04 depend on it and preserve the same product-family identity while changing editorial layout and spread purpose.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-context-shift, 03-surface-study, 04-presentation-master. Queue may run later images concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
